title: Test-Time Training with Masked Autoencoders
mechanism: For each test image, the MAE encoder is trained on masked-patch reconstruction for a few steps, and the task head then predicts from the updated encoder.
adaptation: Needs a ViT MAE encoder; our ResNet-34 does not fit. Only viable if D23/D24 build a ViT segmenter close to FINAL: MAE-pretrain it on the 11.9k pool, fine-tune for segmentation, then run 20-step per-cell TTT on E1.
min_experiment: Arm: ViT segmenter + per-cell MAE TTT. Baseline: the same ViT segmenter without TTT (it must be within 0.01 of FINAL on test). Kill if E1 relF1@2 gains < +0.03.
evidence: R: improves robustness on ImageNet-C and other shift benchmarks with one-sample TTT.
prior_overlap: None at test time. MIM pretraining on ResNet-34 was n.d. (BRIEF s5), but per-image TTT on a ViT was never run.
